2	 * historyProjectFold.ts — applies the "a PROJECT is a CWD" rule
3	 * (lib/knownProjectAggregate.ts) to the History analytics payload.
4	 *
5	 * `history:dashboard` keys every `byProject` row by the encoded
6	 * `~/.claude/projects/<dir>` folder name (historyAggregator.cjs buckets on
7	 * `encodedCwd`), which is a TRANSCRIPT STORE identity, not a project one.
8	 * On this machine that made History's project axis report 2028 projects —
9	 * 2009 of them `-tmp-sm-paged-test-*` / `-tmp-sm-doflush-test-*` fixture
10	 * folders left behind by this repo's own tests. They carry zero tokens and
11	 * zero spend but 4,304 sessions between them, so the `sessions` measure, the
12	 * project count, the facet chips and the concentration panel were all wrong,
13	 * and every label rendered as the raw encoded slug because
14	 * `projectNameFromCwd` has no `/` to split on.
15	 *
16	 * This folds the days by resolved cwd instead. Two folders that resolve to
17	 * one working directory merge into a single project row.
18	 *
19	 * NOTHING IS SILENTLY DROPPED. A key that resolves to no real cwd is removed
20	 * from the project axis — it is not a project — but its totals are returned in
21	 * `excluded` so the UI can state exactly what it left out. Dropping spend
22	 * without saying so would be a lie about money.
23	 *
24	 * Kept pure (no store/window imports) so it is unit-testable directly.
25	 */
26	import type { HistoryDashboardDay, HistoryDashboardProjectRow } from '../../preload/api'
27	
28	export interface ExcludedProjects {
29	  /** How many encoded transcript folders had no resolvable working directory. */
30	  folderCount: number
31	  sessionCount: number
32	  promptCount: number
33	  estimatedCostUsd: number
34	  totalTokens: number
35	}
36	
37	export interface FoldedHistory {
38	  days: HistoryDashboardDay[]
39	  excluded: ExcludedProjects
40	}
41	
42	const EMPTY_EXCLUDED: ExcludedProjects = {
43	  folderCount: 0,
44	  sessionCount: 0,
45	  promptCount: 0,
46	  estimatedCostUsd: 0,
47	  totalTokens: 0,
48	}
49	
50	function mergeRow(into: HistoryDashboardProjectRow, from: HistoryDashboardProjectRow): void {
51	  into.promptCount += from.promptCount
52	  into.inputTokens += from.inputTokens
53	  into.outputTokens += from.outputTokens
54	  into.cacheReadTokens += from.cacheReadTokens
55	  into.cacheCreationTokens += from.cacheCreationTokens
56	  into.toolCallCount += from.toolCallCount
57	  into.sessionCount += from.sessionCount
58	  into.errorCount += from.errorCount
59	  into.activeMinutes += from.activeMinutes
60	  into.estimatedCostUsd += from.estimatedCostUsd
61	  for (const [tool, cnt] of Object.entries(from.toolBreakdown ?? {})) {
62	    into.toolBreakdown[tool] = (into.toolBreakdown[tool] ?? 0) + cnt
63	  }
64	  // byModel feeds facetSlice's model mix — merging the row without it would
65	  // silently drop one folder's model attribution while keeping its totals.
66	  for (const [modelId, mb] of Object.entries(from.byModel ?? {})) {
67	    const dst = into.byModel[modelId] ?? (into.byModel[modelId] = {
68	      inputTokens: 0, outputTokens: 0, cacheReadTokens: 0, cacheCreationTokens: 0, costUsd: 0,
69	    })
70	    dst.inputTokens += mb.inputTokens
71	    dst.outputTokens += mb.outputTokens
72	    dst.cacheReadTokens += mb.cacheReadTokens
73	    dst.cacheCreationTokens += mb.cacheCreationTokens
74	    dst.costUsd += mb.costUsd
75	    if (mb.estimated) dst.estimated = true
76	  }
77	}
78	
79	function cloneRow(row: HistoryDashboardProjectRow, projectDir: string): HistoryDashboardProjectRow {
80	  const byModel: HistoryDashboardProjectRow['byModel'] = {}
81	  for (const [modelId, mb] of Object.entries(row.byModel ?? {})) byModel[modelId] = { ...mb }
82	  return { ...row, projectDir, toolBreakdown: { ...(row.toolBreakdown ?? {}) }, byModel }
83	}
84	
85	/**
86	 * Re-key each day's `byProject` from encoded transcript folder → resolved cwd.
87	 *
88	 * `cwdByEncoded` comes from `useKnownProjects().projects` (encodedIds → cwd).
89	 * Pass an EMPTY map only when resolution genuinely produced nothing; callers
90	 * that are still resolving should skip the fold entirely rather than fold
91	 * against a half-built map, or every project momentarily reads as excluded.
92	 */
93	export function foldHistoryDaysByCwd(
94	  days: HistoryDashboardDay[],
95	  cwdByEncoded: Record<string, string>,
96	): FoldedHistory {
97	  const excluded: ExcludedProjects = { ...EMPTY_EXCLUDED }
98	  const excludedFolders = new Set<string>()
99	
100	  const foldedDays = days.map((day) => {
101	    const byProject: Record<string, HistoryDashboardProjectRow> = {}
102	    for (const [encoded, row] of Object.entries(day.byProject)) {
103	      const cwd = cwdByEncoded[encoded]
104	      if (!cwd) {
105	        excludedFolders.add(encoded)
106	        excluded.sessionCount += row.sessionCount
107	        excluded.promptCount += row.promptCount
108	        excluded.estimatedCostUsd += row.estimatedCostUsd
109	        excluded.totalTokens += row.inputTokens + row.outputTokens
110	        continue
111	      }
112	      const existing = byProject[cwd]
113	      if (existing) mergeRow(existing, row)
114	      else byProject[cwd] = cloneRow(row, cwd)
115	    }
116	    return { ...day, byProject }
117	  })
118	
119	  excluded.folderCount = excludedFolders.size
120	  return { days: foldedDays, excluded }
121	}
122	
123	/** True when there is anything worth telling the user about the exclusion. */
124	export function hasExclusions(e: ExcludedProjects): boolean {
125	  return e.folderCount > 0
126	}
127	
128	export function describeExclusions(e: ExcludedProjects): string {
129	  const bits = [`${e.folderCount} transcript folder${e.folderCount === 1 ? '' : 's'} with no resolvable working directory`]
130	  if (e.sessionCount) bits.push(`${e.sessionCount.toLocaleString()} sessions`)
131	  if (e.promptCount) bits.push(`${e.promptCount.toLocaleString()} prompts`)
132	  if (e.estimatedCostUsd >= 0.005) bits.push(`$${e.estimatedCostUsd.toFixed(2)}`)
133	  return `Excluded: ${bits.join(' · ')}`
134	}"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"8713a9ed-9dff-44e3-ae53-155f0d4dcb51","timestamp":"2026-08-07T02:12:54.613Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"sdk-cli","cwd":"/home/bilko/Projects/session-manager","sessionId":"86339a48-06ac-4690-be8a-0abc21a2f0c5","version":"2.1.220","gitBranch":"main"}
{"parentUuid":"8713a9ed-9dff-44e3-ae53-155f0d4dcb51","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/bilko/Projects/session-manager/src/renderer/lib/knownProjectAggregate.ts","snippet":"1	/**
2	 * knownProjectAggregate.ts — the "a PROJECT is a CWD" rule, in one pure place.
3	 *
4	 * `~/.claude/projects/` is a directory of *transcript stores*, not a directory
5	 * of projects: the CLI mints one folder per encoded path it was ever launched
6	 * from, including throwaway `/tmp` dirs, scratch worktrees and test fixtures,
7	 * and more than one encoded folder can resolve back to the same working
8	 * directory. Treating those folders 1:1 as projects is what made Home report
9	 * "2044 PROJECTS" and list rows named `l2mclS` / `SrR7IF` — those aren't
10	 * projects, they're the last segment of a *fabricated* path produced by
11	 * `candidatePath`'s naive `-`→`/` decode of a folder whose real cwd never
12	 * resolved.
13	 *
14	 * So: the project identity is the resolved cwd (CLAUDE.md's TAB = file
15	 * location = Main Project), and this module is the only thing allowed to
16	 * decide it. Rows whose cwd could not be resolved from transcript content are
17	 * DROPPED rather than guessed at — a fabricated path is worse than no row,
18	 * since every downstream surface (open-in-tab, Epic hydrate, the New-epic
19	 * picker) would then act on a directory that doesn't exist.
20	 *
21	 * Kept dependency-free (plain shapes, no store/window imports) so it is
22	 * unit-testable without mocking zustand or the IPC bridge.
23	 */
24	import type { ProjectRow, EnrichmentState } from './useKnownProjects'
25	import type { ProjectDetails } from './projectEnrichment'
26	
27	export interface ProjectAggregate {
28	  /** Resolved working directory — the project's identity. Unique per row. */
29	  cwd: string
30	  /**
31	   * Display name: the cwd's last path segment. Deliberately NOT package.json's
32	   * `name` (that lives in `details.name`) — the project IS the directory, so
33	   * the label must stay the thing the user picked in the folder picker.
34	   */
35	  name: string
36	  /** Representative transcript folder (the most recently active one). */
37	  encoded: string
38	  /** Every `~/.claude/projects/<encoded>` folder that resolved to this cwd. */
39	  encodedIds: string[]
40	  /** Summed across every folder for this cwd. */
41	  sessionCount: number
42	  /** Summed across every folder for this cwd. */
43	  sizeBytes: number
44	  /** Max across every folder for this cwd. */
45	  lastSession: number
46	  /** Enrichment of the representative folder (git remote, branch, CLAUDE.md preview). */
47	  details: ProjectDetails
48	}
49	
50	/**
51	 * Canonical form of a cwd for identity comparison: collapses repeated slashes
52	 * and strips trailing ones, so `/a/b`, `/a/b/` and `/a//b` are one project.
53	 * Root stays `/`.
54	 */
55	export function normalizeCwd(cwd: string): string {
56	  const collapsed = cwd.trim().replace(/\/{2,}/g, '/')
57	  if (collapsed === '/') return '/'
58	  return collapsed.replace(/\/+$/, '')
59	}
60	
61	export function projectNameFromCwd(cwd: string): string {
62	  const parts = cwd.split('/').filter(Boolean)
63	  return parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : cwd
64	}
65	
66	/**
67	 * Folds the per-transcript-folder rows into one row per unique cwd.
68	 *
69	 * - A row with no resolved cwd (`enriched[encoded].cwd` missing/null/empty) is
70	 *   dropped — see the module header for why we never fall back to a guess.
71	 * - Folders sharing a cwd merge: counts and bytes sum, `lastSession` takes the
72	 *   max, and the folder with the newest activity becomes the representative
73	 *   (its `encoded` and enrichment details are the ones surfaced).
74	 * - Output is sorted most-recently-active first, matching the scan order.
75	 */
76	export function aggregateProjectsByCwd(
77	  rows: ProjectRow[],
78	  enriched: Record<string, EnrichmentState | undefined>,
79	): ProjectAggregate[] {
80	  const byCwd = new Map<string, ProjectAggregate>()
81	
82	  for (const row of rows) {
83	    const raw = enriched[row.encoded]?.cwd
84	    if (typeof raw !== 'string' || raw.trim() === '') continue
85	    const cwd = normalizeCwd(raw)
86	    if (!cwd) continue
87	
88	    const details = detailsOf(enriched[row.encoded])
89	    const existing = byCwd.get(cwd)
90	    if (!existing) {
91	      byCwd.set(cwd, {
92	        cwd,
93	        name: projectNameFromCwd(cwd),
94	        encoded: row.encoded,
95	        encodedIds: [row.encoded],
96	        sessionCount: row.sessionCount,
97	        sizeBytes: row.sizeBytes,
98	        lastSession: row.lastSession,
99	        details,
100	      })
101	      continue
102	    }
103	
104	    existing.encodedIds.push(row.encoded)
105	    existing.sessionCount += row.sessionCount
106	    existing.sizeBytes += row.sizeBytes
107	    // Representative = newest folder, so `details`/`encoded` describe live state.
108	    if (row.lastSession > existing.lastSession) {
109	      existing.encoded = row.encoded
110	      existing.details = details
111	    }
112	    existing.lastSession = Math.max(existing.lastSession, row.lastSession)
113	  }
114	
115	  return [...byCwd.values()].sort((a, b) => b.lastSession - a.lastSession)
116	}
117	
118	function detailsOf(state: EnrichmentState | undefined): ProjectDetails {
119	  if (!state) return {}
120	  const { cwd: _cwd, ...details } = state
121	  return details
122	}"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"2f694fa4-556e-4441-9c2f-a2a777a77a5d","timestamp":"2026-08-07T02:12:54.613Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"sdk-cli","cwd":"/home/bilko/Projects/session-manager","sessionId":"86339a48-06ac-4690-be8a-0abc21a2f0c5","version":"2.1.220","gitBranch":"main"}
